1.w: Now there was a man of the Pharisees, his name Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.

2.w: This one came to Him by night and said to Him, “Rabbi, we know that You have come from God [as] a teacher, for no one is able to do these signs that You do unless God would be with him.”

3.w: Jesus answered and said to him, “Truly, truly, I say to you, unless one would be born from above, he is not able to see the kingdom of God.”

4.w: Nicodemus says to Him, “How is a man able to be born, being old? Is he able to enter into the womb of his mother a second time and to be born?”

5.w: Jesus answered, “Truly, truly, I say to you, unless one would be born of water and of the Spirit, he is not able to enter into the kingdom of God.

6.w: That having been born of the flesh is flesh, and that having been born of the Spirit is spirit.

7.w: Do not marvel that I said to you, ‘It is necessary for you⁺ to be born from above.’

8.w: The wind blows where it wills, and you hear the sound of it, but you do not know from where it comes and where it goes. Thus is everyone having been born of the Spirit.”

9.w: Nicodemus answered and said to Him, “How are these things able to be?”

10.w: Jesus answered and said to him, “You are the teacher of Israel, and you do not know these things?

11.w: Truly, truly, I say to you that we speak what we know, and we testify to what we have seen, and you⁺ do not receive our testimony.

12.w: If I spoke to you⁺ earthly things and you⁺ do not believe, how will you⁺ believe if I should speak to you⁺ heavenly things?

13.w: And no one has gone up into heaven except the One having come down out of heaven, the Son of Man.

14.w: And just as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, thus it is necessary for the Son of Man to be lifted up,

15.w: so that everyone believing in Him may have eternal life.

16.w: For God so loved the world that He gave the Son, the only begotten, so that everyone believing in Him shall not perish but shall have eternal life.

17.w: For God did not send the Son into the world that He might judge the world, but that the world might be saved through Him.

18.w: The one believing in Him is not judged, but the one not believing already has been judged, because he has not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.

19.w: And this is the judgment, that the Light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the Light, for their works were evil.

20.w: For everyone practicing evil hates the Light and does not come to the Light, so that his works may not be exposed;

21.w: but the one doing the truth comes to the Light, so that his works may be manifest, that in God they are having been worked.”

22.w: After these things, Jesus and His disciples went into the land [of] Judea, and there He was staying with them and was baptizing.

23.w: Now John was also baptizing in Aenon near Salim, because the waters were many there, and they were coming and were being baptized.

24.w: For John was not yet thrown into the prison.

25.w: Then a debate arose from the disciples of John with [a] Jew about purification.

26.w: And they came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, the One who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, this One is baptizing, and all are coming to Him.”

27.w: John answered and said, “A man is not able to receive one [thing] unless it shall be given to him from heaven.

28.w: You⁺ yourselves testify to me that I said, ‘I am not the Christ, but I am sent before Him.’

29.w: The one having the bride is the bridegroom, and the friend of the bridegroom, the one standing and hearing him, rejoices with joy because of the voice of the bridegroom. Therefore this joy of mine is fulfilled.

30.w: It is necessary for Him to increase, but [for] me to decrease.

31.w: The One coming from above is above all. The one being from the earth is from the earth and speaks from the earth. The One coming from heaven is above all.

32.w: What He has seen and heard, to this He testifies, and no one receives His testimony.

33.w: The one having received His testimony has sealed that God is true.

34.w: For the One whom God sent speaks the words of God, for He gives the Spirit without measure.

35.w: The Father loves the Son and has given all things into His hand.

36.w: The one believing in the Son has eternal life; but the one not obeying the Son will not see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.”
